Class MenuResource

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.rest.resource.MenuResource
@Component @Path("/menu") @Produces({"application/json","application/xml"}) @Consumes("application/json") public class MenuResource extends Object
REST resource class responsible for menu item operations. Provides CRUD operations for menu items and search functionality.
